subject: Shiny Credentials for different parts of an app

messages.author: d8af3566e6f9ffa7
messages.subject: Shiny Credentials for different parts of an app
parts:
Hi,

Hi All

I am trying to get R used more in our office envoirnment and have been handed a project as a POC. Currently our budget is 0 but i have a virtual machine on which to showcase the results
One of the things that is part of the BRS is that users can only access certain parts of the app if they have the credentials for it

So for example a user can upload a file if he/she is an "uploader" or can view results if they are part of the "viewer" group
The uploading section of the app and the viewing section of the app are in seperate tabs.
So for example if i have two tabs one for viewing and one for uploading, a superuser can see everything, an `uploader` can see just the contents of the upload tab, a viewer can see the `viewer material`, in this case reports. I see from the Rstudio website there is a professional version of the shiny server which could probably do this but to be honest it would be tough to get the finiances for this at the moment.

Is it possible in the free version to do this. Alternatively i could split the app up into 2 apps but want to assess the options first

I have set these groups up in a mySQL DB but my knowledge of shiny is limited but im ok with R in general

Thank you for your time

John
